title: In-operando SEM Imaging of Li-ion Battery Structural Changes During Cycling
content: Scanning electron microscopy (SEM) is a powerful tool for analyzing structural changes in batteries at the micro- and nanoscale [1]. In this study, we present results from an in-operando SEM investigation, with continuous SEM imaging during an entire battery cycling. This in-operando approach provides real-time insights into the dynamics of the structural evolution of electrode components within lithium-ion batteries, offering valuable information for performance optimization and material development.
